title: ER Officer (Advisor)
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A large, values-led organisation currently recruiting an Employee Relations Officer on a fixed-term basis initially. Joining a well-established People team, you will work alongside a dedicated Employee Relations function. This opportunity would suit a HR professional who enjoys managing employee relations casework, building strong relationships with managers and delivering a high-quality people service.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to further develop their employee relations expertise within a supportive and collaborative environment, where learning and development is actively encouraged.

Immediate start available.

The Role

As Employee Relations Officer, you will be responsible for managing a range of employee relations matters and supporting managers across the organisation with practical, timely guidance.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing lower level employee relations cases from initial enquiry through to conclusion.
- Providing advice and support on absence management, disciplinary, grievance and performance-related matters.
- Triaging employee relations queries through a central case management system and ensuring cases are allocated appropriately.
- Coordinating and processing occupational health referrals and supporting managers with recommendations and outcomes.
- Advising managers on policies, procedures and best-practice approaches to people management.
- Supporting investigations, meetings and hearings relating to employee relations matters.
- Maintaining accurate documentation and case records in line with policy and data protection requirements.
- Escalating more complex cases to the senior Employee Relations team where required.
- Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the employee experience and service delivery.

About You

We are keen to speak with candidates who have a solid HR foundation and previous experience supporting employee relations activity. You will ideally bring:
- Experience handling employee relations casework across areas such as absence, performance, disciplinary and grievance. (ESSENTIAL)
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to support managers through sensitive conversations.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied caseload.
- A customer-focused and proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Knowledge of employment legislation and HR best practice.
- Experience working within a large or complex organisation would be advantageous.

CIPD qualification, or progress towards one, would be beneficial, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.

Candidates who have managed absence, grievance, disciplinary and performance cases from start to finish will be of particular interest, although experience managing every stage of a formal disciplinary process is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Pension: Enhanced employer contribution.
- Holiday: 25 days + bank holidays + Christmas shutdown (24 Dec - 5 Jan)
- Flexible Working: 3 days on-site, 2 remote.
- 35 hour working week.
- Extras: Benefits platforms, student discounts plus others.
- Potential for further opportunity and development within the wider organisation.
- Exposure to a broad range of HR casework and stakeholder groups.

What you need to do now:
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: HR Administrator
description:
Job Title: HR Administrator

Location: Sharston, Manchester M22 4 SN

Salary: £27,411.66 per annum

Job type: Full time, Permanent

About us:

Established in 2000, Express Solicitors is an award-winning, no win no fee law firm specialising exclusively in personal injury claims. Headquartered in Manchester, we support clients nationwide across all areas of personal injury, including employers' liability, serious injury, clinical negligence, occupiers' and public liability, road traffic accidents and industrial disease.

We are ranked 64th in The Lawyer UK Top 200, out of more than 10,000 law firms nationwide, and after achieving a 20% year-on-year growth, Express Solicitors are the largest personal injury claimant firm in the UK.

Our commitment to outstanding client care is reflected in our Trustpilot rating of 4.8 (Excellent), placing us among the highest-rated firms in the sector.

About The Role:

We are currently recruiting for a HR Administrator to provide administrative support to our HR Team. This is an exciting opportunity for a talented administrator to join our team and gain valuable HR specialist experience. The right candidate will have the chance to develop their HR career.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate absence records by updating holiday, sickness, medical, and authorised leave information within the HR system.
- Verify that employees enter their data correctly on the HR platform.
- Send a daily absence summary email to all staff.
- Respond to routine staff enquiries in a timely and helpful manner.
- Support the HR team with various projects, such as absenteeism initiatives, company newsletters, HR system improvements, and updates to policies and procedures.
- Coordinate with new starters once an offer is made, including preparing and issuing employment contracts, requesting references, and organising their system setup.
- Deliver induction sessions for new starters.
- Complete checklists for new hires, internal promotions, and leavers to ensure smooth transitions. This includes collaborating with Department Heads and the IT team to share relevant information promptly.
- Ensure personnel files are kept accurate, up-to-date, and well organised.
- Provide general administrative support including filing, scanning, and taking minutes during employee meetings.
- Work with benefits providers, generate ad hoc reports, and liaise with Department Managers as needed.
- Carry out any additional ad hoc duties as required.

Person Specification:
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade 5 or above (or international equivalent).
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Good numerical ability.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
- Flexible and able to prioritise tasks effectively in a dynamic environment.
- Resilient and capable of working under pressure.
- Willing and eager to learn.
- Excellent understanding of confidentiality, with the ability to handle sensitive information discreetly.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident and professional telephone manner.
- High level of accuracy and strong attention to detail.
- Demonstrated ability to coordinate and manage information effectively.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
- Previous HR administration experience and an understanding of UK employment law are desirable but not essential.
- A relevant HR qualification is an advantage.

Salary & Hours:
- Salary of £27,411.66 based on 39.5 hours
- Our standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:30pm Monday-Thursday and 8:30am to 5pm Friday.

Benefits:
- Hybrid Working - 3/2 hybrid working pattern after probation.
- 23 Days Holiday - Rising to 26 days, plus bank/public holidays.
- Extra Holidays - 3 holiday buy backs and an extra day for your birthday after service length requirement.
- Looking After Your Health - Private medical insurance available after 2 years' service, annual flu jab and Employee Assistance Programme.
- Looking After Your Well-being - 24/7 onsite Gym, Netball/Football team, 10km Manchester team and more.
- Work Life / Balance - Active social committee with generous departmental and firm-wide social budget.

Recruitment Process:

Interviews will be conducted by MS Teams and will include scenario-based questioning.

Our employees are our most important asset, we rate skill and ability above all else and our recruitment policy encourages applications from all.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of; HR Assistant, Human Resources Assistant, Human Resources Executive, HR Executive, Human Resources Administrator, HR Advisor, Human Resources Advisor, HR Generalist, Human Resources Admin, HR Officer, HR Admin may also be considered for this role.

title: Assistant Company Secretary
description:
Job Description

Good governance might happen behind the scenes, but it plays an important part in helping a business run well, make good decisions and earn the trust of its customers.

At AJ Bell, our purpose is to help people feel good investing. To deliver that, we need strong governance, clear accountability and people who are confident working at the heart of a listed business.

We're looking for an Assistant Company Secretary to join our expanding Company Secretarial team and help support the effective running of our Board, Executive Committee and their sub-committees.

This is a great opportunity to join a developing function where you'll have plenty of exposure across the business and the chance to make a real contribution. You'll work closely with senior leaders while also getting involved in the detail that keeps our governance framework running smoothly.

What does the job involve?

Reporting to the General Counsel & Company Secretary, you'll support the day-to-day operation of the Company Secretarial function. Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing agendas, Board and committee packs, management information and meeting materials.
- Attending Board and committee meetings and producing accurate, high-quality minutes.
- Coordinating meeting schedules, annual agendas, action logs and follow-up activity.
- Supporting our governance and regulatory obligations, including requirements under company law, the Listing Rules and Market Abuse Regulation (MAR).
- Contributing to governance sections of the Annual Report and supporting preparation for the AGM.
- Maintaining statutory registers and ensuring accurate and timely Companies House filings.
- Supporting the induction and ongoing training of Board and Executive Committee members.
- Helping maintain internal governance policies, our share dealing code and insider lists.
- Supporting Board and committee effectiveness reviews and helping ensure actions are followed through.

You'll also work closely with colleagues across the business, including HR, Compliance and Finance, and support wider projects such as incentive schemes and the Senior Managers & Certification Regime (SM&CR).

What are we looking for?

You'll already have experience within company secretarial, corporate governance or a closely related environment and be comfortable working with senior stakeholders and confidential information.

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:
- Experience working in a company secretarial or corporate governance role, ideally gained over four or more years.
- Part or full CGI/ICSA qualification, although this isn't essential if you have strong relevant experience.
- Strong experience preparing agendas, Board papers and high-quality minutes.
- Confidence using electronic Board portals and coordinating Board and committee materials.
- Experience with statutory filings, registers and entity management.
- A good understanding of company law, governance requirements and best practice.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

Experience within a listed company or financial services environment would be useful, but we're interested in the overall experience and perspective you can bring.

Most importantly, you'll be someone who takes ownership, uses good judgement and wants to contribute to a collaborative and evolving function.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

What we offer
- Salary from £55,000
- 25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays
- 6% Pension with matched contributions
- Discretionary bonus scheme
- Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)
- Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare
- Free onsite gym
- Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)
- Travel and bike loan schemes
- Employee Assistance Programme

Life at AJ Bell
- Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties
- Learning and development opportunities tailored to you
- Casual dress code
- Friendly, supportive team environment

Our ways of working

We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.

For new starters, there's an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.

Inclusion & diversity

We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.
